run_download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess S2EF training data for a specified split like 200k or 2M
run_download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract IS2RE train val test LMDB datasets
run_download_s2ef_test: run the download_data script to download and move S2EF test data into the s2ef/all directory
run_download_with_cleanup: run the download_data script with intermediate file cleanup enabled after downloading and preprocessing data
run_download_keep_intermediate: run the download_data script with the keep flag to retain intermediate directories and files after processing
